name: Canvas Jewelry API
description: NestJS API for the Canvas Jewelry storefront — orders, OTP, and translations.

JWT_SECRET.description: Signs OTP verification tokens / hashes codes. Min 32 chars.

STAFF_API_KEY.description: Shared secret guarding the staff endpoints (/orders*, /admin/translations*). Min 16 chars.

CORS_ORIGIN.description: Comma-separated allowed frontend origins (client + admin). Leave empty to allow any origin (NOT recommended in production).

AWS_REGION.description: AWS region for the STL bucket.

S3_BUCKET.description: S3 bucket name for order STL files.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: AWS access key with S3 access.

S3_PRESIGN_TTL_SEC.description: Presigned download URL lifetime in seconds.

TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID.description: Twilio account SID (optional — without it OTPs are logged, not sent).

DB_SYNCHRONIZE.description: Must stay false — schema changes go through migrations.
